* A {@link ViewPager} which wraps around its tallest child's height. *

Normally {@link ViewPager} instances expand their height to cover all remaining space in * the layout. *

This class is used for the intent resolver and share sheet's tabbed view.

methods.name: protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
void setSwipingEnabled(boolean swipingEnabled)
methods.comment:
* Sets whether swiping sideways should happen. *

Note that swiping is always disabled for RTL layouts (b/159110029 for context).

methodNames: protected void onMeasure(int widthMeasureSpec, int heightMeasureSpec)
